```sql
SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(units) AS DOUBLE) AS answer
FROM (
    -- POS transaction lines (Tableware, December 2025)
    SELECT 
        t.quantity AS units
    FROM staging.stg_pos__transaction_lines t
    JOIN staging.stg_erp__materials m ON t.sku = m.sku
    WHERE t.txn_date >= '2025-12-01' 
      AND t.txn_date <= '2025-12-31'
      AND m.product_category = 'Tableware'
      AND t.is_valid = true

    UNION ALL

    -- Ecom order lines (Tableware, December 2025)
    SELECT 
        ol.quantity AS units
    FROM staging.stg_ecom__order_lines ol
    JOIN staging.stg_ecom__orders o ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN staging.stg_erp__materials m ON ol.sku = m.sku
    WHERE o.order_date >= '2025-12-01' 
      AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31'
      AND m.product_category = 'Tableware'
      AND o.order_status != 'cancelled'

    UNION ALL

    -- ERP Sales Order lines (Tableware, December 2025)
    SELECT 
        sol.quantity AS units
    FROM staging.stg_erp__sales_order_lines sol
    JOIN staging.stg_erp__materials m ON sol.material_id = m.material_id
    WHERE sol.order_date >= '2025-12-01' 
      AND sol.order_date <= '2025-12-31'
      AND m.product_category = 'Tableware'
) all_lines;
```
